short: framework objects and their line formats
is: The backend-blind types (epics, tasks, asks, answers, findings, instances, profiles, ids, labels) and the text formats they travel in, each with its parser, plus the verbatim quote check.
conventions: Imports no other layer, only the crate's text_newtype macro
A format with rules gets its own error type (AskError, AnswerError, IdError, TaskTemplateError)

fs.name: answer.rs
fs.role: keeper answer: verdict, citations, word limit

fs.name: ask.rs
fs.role: ask record: up to five typed questions

fs.name: instance.rs
fs.role: a role run numbered on its epic, and its slug

fs.name: profile.rs
fs.role: context profiles: lean, build, design, review

fs.name: quote.rs
fs.role: verbatim quote check against the cited page

fs.name: task.rs
fs.role: task ticket template: one Field: value per line

notes: Task fields: Goal, Owned paths, Interfaces, Design pages, Architecture, Acceptance, Tests, Security trigger, Model, Size; check reads Tests, Architecture and Acceptance
Task labels ready, claimed, blocked, question, done and page statuses decided, current, proposed, superseded are the vocabularies shared with the board and design source
Ask kinds are fact, rule, term, exists, where
